# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security problems privately through GitHub:
**Security ▸ Report a vulnerability** on <https://github.com/cpCr4zy/RustGuiSpec/security>.
Do not open a public issue for them.

Relevant here: anything in the template that a generated project inherits, e.g. the release
workflow (secrets, permissions, third-party actions), packaging scripts, `new-project.sh`, or a
dependency or setting the specification recommends. You should get an answer within a week.

Only the latest commit on `main` is supported; projects made earlier take fixes over by hand
(`docs/template-origin.txt` records the template commit they started from).
